## 3-gate self-check

- [ ] **Generalizable** — another SaaS / founder would hit this (not just my project/stack)
- [ ] **Recurring** — a class of problem, not a one-off
- [ ] **Survives redaction** — still true & useful after removing names/stack/secrets

(If not all three, it probably stays a source-project note — that's fine.)

## Where it'd go

- [ ] `quality-scripts/` — a new `check-*` (greppable signature → prefer a machine check)
- [ ] `governance-skills/` or `enforcement/` — AI behavior rule / guard
- [ ] `lifecycle/<stage>/` — method / template / checklist
- [ ] `methodology/` — cognitive trap / drift pattern
- [ ] `registries/` — business-rule pattern
- [ ] `ops/` — process
